coverage.evidence: The queue panel is on Home only with moderation:queue:read (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/home/HomeView.vue:130,191). Allow and Deny need moderation:queue:resolve (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:103). The history needs moderation:history:read, and without it the dialog shows profile.history.noAccess (dashboard/src/components/layout/profile/ProfileHistory.vue:35,50-53; dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json profile.history.noAccess). All three default to Mod=10, which is Moderator and every role above it (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54,242-243,251). The Permissions page sets the lowest role per action (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/permissions/i18n/en.json:379). The Moderation tab is in BASE_TABS (dashboard/src/components/layout/profile/profileTabs.ts:18).

The Moderation tab holds ProfileNotes, ProfileHistory, the Actions taken counts, ProfileSuspicious and the ban history (dashboard/src/components/layout/profile/ProfileView.vue:376-404). History entries come newest first (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/ModerationHistoryService.cs, OrderByDescending(OccurredAt)). Each entry shows the action, the reason, and the moderator or Automatic with the date (ProfileHistory.vue:55-74,88-92). The kind labels and Show older match en.json profile.history.kinds and profile.history.more. The Access group and its pages match dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:83-96. Shoutouts is in the Bot group (settingsNavigation.ts:59) and Federation is in the Connections group (settingsNavigation.ts:70).

Only an AutoMod row is relayed to Twitch through ManageHeldAutoModMessageAsync, and every other row is resolved locally (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Moderation/ModerationQueueService.cs:308-328,354-359). The deny waits DEFAULT_UNDO_MS = 6000 (dashboard/src/composables/useInlineFlow.ts:41) on a timer (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:60-65). Undo clears that timer (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:67-70). Leaving the page sends every pending deny at once (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:73-78). The row shows Denied and Undo (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:112; components/layout/InlineFlow.vue:158-164).

AutoMod and chat holds: ModerationQueueEventHandlers.cs:26-85. Chat filter Hold deletes the message and queues it, Flag only queues it, and both are Twitch only (EventHandlers/ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:158-175,265-275). The newcomer gate queues only a message it really removed, when HoldsForReview is set, on any provider (AccountAgeGateExecutor.cs:67-83). HoldsForReview defaults to true (Domain/Moderation/SpamDefense/SpamDefenseDefaults.cs:37). Suspicious users are queued and their messages are never deleted (EventHandlers/SuspiciousUserHandlers.cs:41-76). The heat limit flags a viewer when auto timeout is off or the viewer is immune, with the text 'Heat reached N (threshold T)' (EventHandlers/HeatThresholdAutoTimeoutHandler.cs:97-116,234-241). The dashboard sends only {action} and no followUp (dashboard/src/api/home.ts:297), so the server's followUp defaults to none and no timeout or ban runs (ModerationQueueService.cs:266,362-366).

reader_answers.evidence: The queue on Home (HomeView.vue:191), the Moderation tab (profileTabs.ts:18), the Access settings group (settingsNavigation.ts:83-96) and the chat line Timeout and Ban controls behind moderation:ban (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/chat/components/ChatLine.vue:173,460-506) all exist as the answer describes.

queue:read, queue:resolve and history:read all default to Mod=10, which covers Moderator, Lead moderator, Editor and Broadcaster (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54,242-243,251). The role labels are in settings/permissions/i18n/en.json:10-13.

Allow removes the row through an optimistic save and a refetch of the pending items (api/home.ts:277-307). Deny shows Denied and Undo, then sends after 6000 ms (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:60-65,112; useInlineFlow.ts:41). Only an AutoMod row relays to Twitch (ModerationQueueService.cs:308-328).

The queue row title is plain text in SummaryRow (ReviewQueuePanel.vue:102). The People page has a 'Search people' field (views/dashboard/people/i18n/en.json:6) and opens the same ProfileView in a pane beside the list (PeopleView.vue:351,371,467-470). The Moderation tab holds the history (ProfileView.vue:377). An AutoMod Allow is relayed to Twitch and a filter Allow is recorded locally only (ModerationQueueService.cs:308-328).
